figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. The cyclopiane family of diterpenes and their synthetic design. a) Skeleton of cyclopiane diterpene and distribution of the modifications at
different positions. b–d) Representative structures of cyclopiane diterpenes with modifications at ring A (b), rings A and B (c), and rings A and D
(d). e) Biosynthesis of deoxyconidiogenol catalysed by terpene cyclases from DMAPP and IPP. f) Representative structures of cyclopiane-related
diterpenes. GGPP, geranylgeranyl diphosphate; DMAPP, dimethylally diphosphate; IPP, isopentenyl diphosphate.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Scheme 1. Chemoenzymatic synthesis of the cyclopiane family of diterpenes. a) Preparation of deoxyconidiogenol (11) by heterologous host. b)
Direct redox operations of 11 for the synthesis of cyclopiane diterpenes with modified A ring. c) Synthesis of conidiogenone G (4) via directed C� H
oxidation. d) Synthesis of cyclopiane diterpenes with modifications of ring D by late-stage enzymatic hydroxylation. IBX, 2-iodoxybenzoic acid;
PTSA, p-toluenesulfonic acid; DMSO, dimethyl sulfoxide; B2Pin2, bis(pinacolato)diboron; L-selectride, lithium tri-sec-butylborohydride; DMF, N,N-
dimethylformamide; PIDA, phenyliodine(III)diacetate; TBSOTf, tert-butyldimethylsilyl trifluoromethanesulfonate; m-CPBA, 3-chloroperbenzoic acid;
DCE, 1,2-dichloroethane; TPAP, tetrapropylammonium perruthenate; NMO, N-methylmorpholine N-oxide; MS, molecular sieves; LDA, lithium
diisopropylamide; 9-BBN, 9-borabicyclo[3.3.1]nonane; MOMCl, chloro(methoxy)methane; DIPEA, N,N-diisopropylethylamine; TBAF, tetra-n-
butylammonium fluoride; TFA, trifluoroacetic acid; TCDI, 1,1’-thiocarbonyldiimidazole; DMAP, dimethylaminopyridine.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Scheme 2. Skeletal diversification of cyclopiane-related diterpenes. a) Acid-mediated skeletal transformation of deoxyconidiogenol (11) and 1-epi-
deoxyconidiogenol (24). b) Exploration of the skeletal diversity of cyclopiane-related diterpenes by genome mining.
